questions.q: What is mitosis for, according to the example at the start of the video?
o: So that a lizard can regrow its tail
questions.e: In the video: "Da bi gušteru izrastao rep" — so that a lizard can regrow its tail.

questions.q: What did all of us arise from, according to the author?
o: From a single fertilized egg cell
questions.e: In the video: "svi smo mi nastali od jedne jedine oplođene jajne ćelije" — all of us arose from a single fertilized egg cell.

questions.q: How many chromosomes does a human have?
questions.e: In the video: "Hromozoma kod čoveka ima 46" — humans have 46 chromosomes.

questions.q: What does the number of chromosomes in different species show?
o: The complexity of an organism does not depend on the number of chromosomes
The more chromosomes, the smarter the organism
questions.e: In the video: "složenost organizma nema nikakve veze sa količinom hromozoma" — the complexity of an organism has nothing to do with the number of chromosomes.

questions.q: What is a chromosome made of two sister chromatids?
o: A doubled chromosome joined by a centromere
questions.e: In the video: "hromozom koji se sastoji od dve sestrinske hromatide" — a chromosome consisting of two sister chromatids.

questions.q: What is the whole stage of preparing for division called?
questions.e: In the video: "Pa ceo onaj deo pripreme za deobu zove se interfaza" — well, that whole stage of preparing for division is called interphase.

questions.q: What happens in metaphase?
o: The chromosomes line up in the middle
questions.e: In the video: "a hromozomi u sredini, to je metafaza" — and the chromosomes in the middle, that's metaphase.

questions.q: What is the result of mitosis?
questions.e: In the video: "mitoza daje nove identične ćelije" — mitosis produces new identical cells.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Svaka *ćelija* ima jedro.
questions.e: Ćelija — a cell.

questions.q: Hromozomi su u *jedru*.
questions.e: Jedro — the nucleus (of a cell).

questions.q: Mitoza je ćelijska *deoba*.
questions.e: Deoba — division.

questions.q: DNK se *udvostručava*.
questions.e: Udvostručiti — to double.

questions.q: Hromatide se kreću ka *polovima*.
questions.e: Pol — a pole.

questions.q: Gušter dobija novi *rep*.
questions.e: Rep — a tail.

questions.q: *Nasledni* materijal je DNK.
questions.e: Nasledni — hereditary.

questions.q: Hromozomi se postavljaju na *sredini*.
questions.e: Sredina — the middle.

questions.q: Ćelija se sprema za ___.
questions.e: Spremati se za + accusative case: za deobu.

questions.q: Imamo dve nove ___.
questions.e: Dve + nominative plural: dve ćelije.

questions.q: Broj hromozoma je konstantan i karakterističan za ___.
questions.e: Za + accusative case: za vrstu.

questions.q: Iz svakog para jedan dolazi ___ oca, a drugi od majke.
questions.e: Dolaziti od + genitive means "to come from": od oca, od majke.

questions.q: i tek tada je spremna za ___ deobu, odnosno za svoju smrt,
questions.e: Za + accusative. Deoba is feminine, so za novu deobu.

questions.q: Hromatide odlaze na ___.
questions.e: Na + accusative case (where to): na polove.

questions.q: Citoplazma se ugiba na tom ___ mestu.
questions.e: Na + locative case, neuter: na središnjem mestu.

questions.q: Mitoza je stalno prisutna u ___ kože.
questions.e: U + locative plural: u ćelijama.
